title: Cosmic Jellyfish Dream
description: A pair of human hands holds a glowing crystal sphere containing a miniature house and garden. Above, a large ethereal jellyfish with multiple eyes floats in a starry night sky beside a full moon that also contains an eye. The scene includes a white picket fence, purple flowers, and wheat stalks in a surreal night garden.
